name: The Goode Seamstress
desc1: The inside of this shop is stocked with delicate threads and
desc2: embroidery.  Each garment has been carefully sewn and is displayed
desc3: just so.  Robes are neatly folded in the polished glass case, or hung
desc4: on the wall to catch your eye when you first enter the shop.  The
desc5: seamstress is immaculately groomed with a bun piled up on top of her
desc6: head.  She greets you with a tight smile.
